messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Apr 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal trajectory, capacity uplift & QBR coordination

Jordan —

Thanks again for the productive renewal check last week. As discussed, I wanted to kick off a short, focused plan to lock in the term amendment and the capacity uplift for Utheon so we have runway into H2. High level ask: confirm a preferred QBR slot and any procurement timelines so we can align the contract amendment and capacity provisioning.

Proposed next steps (editable):
- Share a one-page Mutual Action Plan (attached) for review by your stakeholders (we can convert to your template).
- Quick capacity profile from our side (how many request units and burst headroom we recommend) — Marcus is looping below.
- QBR — propose two 60-minute options next week: Tue 15 Apr 10:00–11:00 PT or Thu 17 Apr 14:00–15:00 PT.
- Procurement/Legal: identify the approver and any SLA/term constraints (if you need a redline, please send the current PoV).

I've attached a starter Mutual Action Plan and a small CSV with our capacity sketch. If neither QBR slot works, send a couple of alternatives and we'll run a quick Doodle.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this over the line smoothly.

—
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0172

Attachments: Utheon_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx (xlsx), capacity_profile_Q1-Q3.csv (csv)

From: Jordan Park <jordan@utheon.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Megan Li <megan.li@utheon.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Apr 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal trajectory, capacity uplift & QBR coordination

Hannah —

Appreciate the clear plan. Both Megan (procurement) and I reviewed the MAP — looks good as a starting point. A few notes from our side:

- We are planning for a 30% increase in peak tokens for H2 (mainly inference for new conversational flows). Can you confirm recommended reserved capacity and burst behavior for that delta?
- Procurement: Megan is our point for legal/PO. She needs to see term language around data residency and an explicit SLA target for 99.9% availability.
- QBR slots: Thu 17 Apr 14:00–15:00 PT works best for our execs.

Can Marcus send a succinct capacity recommendation (numbers + cost delta) and we can put Procurement in copy for the amendment review. Also, please include a one-page appendix that outlines rollback/fallback models if we experience latency regressions after migration.

Thanks,
Jordan
VP Product, Utheon
jordan@utheon.com

Subject: RE: Renewal trajectory, capacity uplift & QBR coordination

Jordan / team —

Quick capacity sketch attached. Summary:

- Current steady-state tokens/day (avg): 120M
- Peak tokens/minute observed: 1.6M
- Recommended committed reserve for H2: +30% steady-state ≈ 156M tokens/day equivalent (reserve sizing assumes continuous batching and prefix caching across the new flows).
- Recommended burst headroom: additional 2x short-term (sustained for up to 5 mins) to handle launch spikes.
- Estimated cost delta (committed vs current): ~+$18k/mo (pro forma).

Also attached: a one-page rollback/fallback playbook (short bullets) and the CSV with per-quarter projections. Ben, can you prepare a redline summary of the standard term language for 99.9% SLA and data residency notes (we'll keep it short for Procurement)?

Marcus Lin
Platform Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Attachments: capacity_profile_Q1-Q3.csv (csv), rollback_playbook_v1.pdf (pdf)

Jordan / Megan —

Perfect, thanks for confirming the Thu 17 Apr slot. I've sent a calendar invite (QBR_availability_poll.ics attached) for 14:00–15:00 PT; please accept if that works for your broader team.

Action items we have now:
- Marcus: finalize the capacity recommendation and cost delta by EOD tomorrow (attached CSV + short playbook).
- Ben: provide a 1-page term summary + suggested redlines for 99.9% SLA & data residency (cc'd).
- Hannah: prepare the QBR agenda and a one-page mutual action plan for signature.
- Utheon: confirm procurement timeline — if you can share target PO date, we'll align invoice/runway.

If Procurement needs a draft amendment earlier for internal review, we'll prioritize a clean redline after Ben sends the summary. Appreciate the quick turnaround — want to ensure production continuity for your new conversational flows.

Best,
Hannah
